asks: Who audits the recipes that ship with Silo?
answer: Silo audits the recipes and pieces it ships, and updates them as new versions pass the audit. Every version in them is pinned. A new version is taken only once it has been public for three days, so that a poisoned release is usually found and pulled first. A fix for a known security hole may skip the wait, and the update says so. Before an update ships, Silo reads what changes in the computer the recipe makes: the packages added, removed or changed, and what each runs when it is installed. A recipe you write is yours to audit.
